_comment: Tier-2 for febio::linear_elasticity#5. <nu> inside 'isotropic elastic' gives 'tag "nu" (line N) : unrecognized tag' with 'Reading file ...FAILED!' and exit 1; the same deck with <v> runs to normal termination and prints neither string. NOTE ON RE-KEYING: the fixture missing_control_silent_zero_result carried pitfall_index 5 while its subject is the dropped-<Control> pitfall, which is index 3 — the index had drifted as pitfalls were inserted, so the runner key attributed the Control evidence to the Poisson-ratio claim. Both were re-keyed in the same pass. The positive control — the same deck with only the one wrong thing put right — is what makes the observed message attributable to the trigger rather than to anything else in the deck. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
